answer: Trust-flow admission: an agent's voting weight equals the max-flow of vouches reaching it from a seed grove of long-established agents, and every vouch is backed by the voucher's bonded stake. A sybil farm can mint thousands of names, but they all hang off the same thin jetty of edges into the honest graph, so their combined flow is capped by those few bonds, which get slashed once any member is caught cheating. Fakes add no extra weight, so the honest graph stays a haven.
